newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Gulf of Mexico production soars.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Gulf of Mexico production soars.

text.p: Coastal Corp said Tuesday its daily production levels of oil and natural gas from the Gulf of Mexico more than tripled during 1996.
During the year, Coastal set two platforms in the Gulf of Mexico, and plans call for the construction of an additional eight structures in 1997, it said.

The company said its natural gas production increased to 145 million cubic feet per day at year's end from 47 million a year earlier. Net oil and gas condensate production increased to 4,200 barrels per day from 3,760 barrels daily.

Coastal announced Tuesday another natural gas discovery on the High Island 519A block in the Sar "H" formation. The 519A No. 5 Well logged about 52 feet of net pay sand in an untested fault block at a depth of 8,050 feet.
